correctness.rationale: Lee-Guzmán et al Proposition 10.4 eq (51) supplies an exact direct-integral 2x2 Hermite Gram matrix for the strip. Integrating h0,h1 explicitly gives matrix entries A,B,C and at x=0 top eigenvalue erf(a), with positive curvature 4ae^-a²/sqrt(pi), so zero is strictly locally minimal. For a↓0 compact-uniform rank-one Gram convergence and a Gaussian trace tail yield maximizers |x|→1/sqrt2 and M(a)/a→4e^-1/2/sqrt(pi). For a→∞, Q=I-Γ is sum of two positive Gaussian-tail Gram matrices; determinant expansion, Mills ratio and the lower-bound localization inequality force ax-log(2a)=O(1). On this scale lambda_min(Q) is e^-a²/(2sqrt(pi)a³)(e^{2s}+e^{-2s})(1+o(1)) uniformly over bounded s, minimized at s=0, giving sharp leakage and optimizer displacement. Independent high-precision evaluation at a=3,5,8,12 showed the normalized competitor leakage tending toward one. Fiber maximizer is not asserted to be a global L2 eigenvector.
